_about.en: Fixed message templates of the rules watch, English and Chinese side by side. The Chinese text is written here by hand; the watcher never machine-translates the organisers' pages. Placeholders in braces must be the same in both languages (tests/test_rules_watch.py checks it).
_about.zh: 规则监测使用的固定消息模板，中英文并列。中文是人工写好的模板，监测程序从不机器翻译主办方页面。两种语言的花括号占位符必须一致（tests/test_rules_watch.py 会检查）。

changes.title.en: # VEC rules and contract watch: changelog
changes.title.zh: # VEC 规则与契约监测：变更记录

changes.intro.en: Newest first. One entry per run that found a change. Written by `python -m vec_rules_watch run` (a daily GitHub Action of vec-community-kit) from the public pages of https://virtualembryo.ai/challenge, the board contract (panels/index.json and the gene lists), the phase endpoint and the organisers' scorer veckit on GitHub. Quoted lines are short excerpts (at most 200 characters each); the organisers' pages are the authoritative text. How it works and its limits: vec_rules_watch/README.md. Chinese version: CHANGES.zh.md.
changes.intro.zh: 最新的在最上面。每次运行发现变化就写一条。由 `python -m vec_rules_watch run`（vec-community-kit 的每日 GitHub Action）根据 https://virtualembryo.ai/challenge 的公开页面、榜契约（panels/index.json 和基因列表）、阶段接口以及 GitHub 上主办方的打分器 veckit 生成。引用的行是简短摘录（每条最多 200 个字符），保留英文原文；以主办方页面为准。原理和局限见 vec_rules_watch/README.md。英文版：CHANGES.md。

entry.first_run.en: First run: this entry records the starting point. Later entries list what changed against it.
entry.first_run.zh: 首次运行：本条记录起点，之后的条目列出相对它的变化。

entry.rebaseline.en: The cache holding the previous full page text was missing or out of step with this repository, so pages were compared by section hash only: changed sections are named, no lines are quoted. The pages were re-baselined.
entry.rebaseline.zh: 保存上次完整页面文本的缓存丢失，或与本仓库对不上，所以这次只按小节哈希比较页面：只列出改动的小节名，不引用具体行。页面已重新建立基线。

entry.fetch_errors.en: Could not fetch in this run: {sources}. Their previous snapshot is kept; a change there shows up on the next successful run.
entry.fetch_errors.zh: 本次未能获取：{sources}。保留上一次的快照；那里如果有变化，会在下一次成功运行时出现。

entry.impact.en: What this changes for your file: {text}
entry.impact.zh: 对你的文件意味着什么：{text}

contract.baseline.zh: 基线：index.json 中共有 {n} 个榜。

contract.board_added.en: New board {board} ({label}): task {task}, split {split}, {n_genes} genes ({genes_file}), cells {min_cells}-{max_cells}, coordinates: {coords}.
contract.board_added.zh: 新增榜 {board}（{label}）：任务 {task}，切分 {split}，{n_genes} 个基因（{genes_file}），细胞数 {min_cells}-{max_cells}，坐标：{coords}。

impact.board_added.en: A file for {board} needs exactly this board's gene list in its order ({n_genes} genes) and {min_cells} to {max_cells} cells; coordinates: {coords}. The kit's validator reads the new contract with VEC_PANELS_DIR={panels_dir}.
impact.board_added.zh: {board} 的文件必须严格使用该榜的基因列表及其顺序（{n_genes} 个基因），细胞数在 {min_cells} 到 {max_cells} 之间；坐标：{coords}。设置 VEC_PANELS_DIR={panels_dir} 即可让工具包的校验器读取新契约。

contract.board_removed.en: Board {board} ({label}) is no longer in index.json.

impact.board_removed.en: Check the submit page before you upload to {board}: the portal may no longer accept files for it.
impact.board_removed.zh: 上传到 {board} 之前先看提交页：门户可能已不再接受这个榜的文件。

contract.genes_changed.en: {board}: gene panel changed: {old_n} -> {new_n} genes, {added} added, {removed} removed{order_note}; genes_sha256 {old_sha} -> {new_sha}.
contract.genes_changed.zh: {board}：基因面板变了：{old_n} -> {new_n} 个基因，新增 {added} 个，移除 {removed} 个{order_note}；genes_sha256 {old_sha} -> {new_sha}。

genes.order_changed.en: , the order of the kept genes changed
genes.order_changed.zh: ，保留下来的基因顺序也变了

impact.genes_changed.en: Rebuild your {board} file with the new gene list in the new order (var_names must match element by element); a file with the old panel is rejected.
impact.genes_changed.zh: 请用新的基因列表、按新的顺序重新生成 {board} 的文件（var_names 必须逐个对上）；用旧面板的文件会被拒。

impact.cells_changed.en: A {board} file must now have between {new_min} and {new_max} cells; the portal rejects a file outside the bounds.
impact.cells_changed.zh: {board} 的文件现在必须有 {new_min} 到 {new_max} 个细胞；超出范围的文件会被门户拒绝。

impact.obsm_required.zh: {board} 的文件必须在 .obsm 中带上 {keys}。

impact.obsm_none.en: No .obsm key is required for {board} any more.

impact.obs_changed.en: Check the .obs columns of your {board} file against the new list.
impact.obs_changed.zh: 请按新列表检查 {board} 文件的 .obs 列。

impact.coords_on.en: {board} now needs 3D coordinates in your file.
impact.coords_on.zh: {board} 现在要求文件里有三维坐标。

impact.anchors_changed.en: The 0-100 scale of {board} moves for {metric}: scores made with the old anchors (local ones too) are not comparable with new ones.
impact.anchors_changed.zh: {board} 在 {metric} 上的 0-100 分尺度变了：用旧锚点算出的分数（包括本地分数）不能和新分数直接比较。

impact.anchor_set.en: The metric panel of {board} may have changed; read the scoring section of the evaluation page.
impact.anchor_set.zh: {board} 的指标组合可能变了；请阅读评测页的打分部分。

impact.stage_changed.en: The target stage of {board} changed: re-check which released stages you predict from.
impact.stage_changed.zh: {board} 的目标阶段变了：请重新确认你用哪些已发布的阶段来预测。

contract.sha_mismatch.en: {board}: the published {genes_file} does not match index.json (genes_sha256 {expected}, the list gives {got}; {n} genes, n_genes {expected_n}). The kit's validator refuses such a panel; tell the organisers.
contract.sha_mismatch.zh: {board}：发布的 {genes_file} 与 index.json 对不上（genes_sha256 为 {expected}，列表算出 {got}；列表 {n} 个基因，n_genes 为 {expected_n}）。工具包的校验器会拒绝这样的面板；请告知主办方。

phase.baseline.en: Baseline: phase {phase} ({label}), board {board}, split {split}, daily_quota {daily_quota}, accepts_submissions {accepts_submissions}, nominations_open {nominations_open}.

impact.phase_changed.en: The challenge is in a new phase: re-read the timeline and the rules before your next upload.
impact.phase_changed.zh: 比赛进入了新阶段：下次上传前请重读时间线和规则。

impact.board_changed.en: New submissions are scored on the {new} board: check the keys and cell bounds of its boards (board contract above).
impact.board_changed.zh: 新提交在 {new} 榜上计分：请核对这些榜的 key 和细胞数范围（见上面的榜契约）。

impact.quota_changed.en: Plan your uploads for the new quota.

phase.accepts_submissions.true.zh: 门户接受提交（accepts_submissions 为 true）。

phase.accepts_submissions.false.en: The portal stopped accepting submissions (accepts_submissions false).
phase.accepts_submissions.false.zh: 门户停止接受提交（accepts_submissions 为 false）。

phase.shows_scores.false.zh: 不显示分数（shows_scores 为 false）。

phase.nominations_open.true.en: Nominations are open: a final entry can be nominated now (nominations_open true).
phase.nominations_open.true.zh: 提名已开放：现在可以提名最终参赛作品（nominations_open 为 true）。

phase.nominations_open.false.zh: 提名已关闭（nominations_open 为 false）。

phase.data_open.true.zh: 数据下载已开放（data_open 为 true）。

phase.data_open.false.zh: 数据下载已关闭（data_open 为 false）。

scorer.baseline.en: Baseline: {repo} {branch} at {sha} ({date}), version {version}; tags: {tags}; releases: {releases}; branches: {branches}.
scorer.baseline.zh: 基线：{repo} 的 {branch} 分支位于 {sha}（{date}），版本 {version}；标签：{tags}；发布：{releases}；分支：{branches}。

impact.head_moved.en: The organisers' scorer changed. Read the commit before you trust local scores; this kit's vec_local_score pins veckit {pinned}.
impact.head_moved.zh: 主办方的打分器变了。相信本地分数之前先看这次提交；本工具包的 vec_local_score 固定使用 veckit {pinned}。

scorer.tag_removed.zh: 标签 {tag} 被删除（原位于 {sha}）。

scorer.branch_removed.zh: 分支 {branch} 被删除（原位于 {sha}）。

pages.baseline.zh: 已为 {n} 个页面记录基线。

page.section_changed_hash.zh: 有改动（只按哈希判断，没有逐行细节）：“{heading}”

page.order_changed.en: The order of the sections changed.

page.excerpt_label.zh: 改动的行（英文原文的简短摘录）：

hint.rules.en: The rules decide what is allowed and what is prize-eligible: read the changed sections on the page in full.
hint.rules.zh: 规则决定什么允许、什么有获奖资格：请到原页面完整阅读改动的小节。

hint.terms.en: The terms of use changed: read the changed sections on the page.
hint.terms.zh: 使用条款变了：请到原页面阅读改动的小节。

hint.timeline.en: Dates may have moved: check your plan against the new schedule.
hint.timeline.zh: 日期可能变了：请按新的日程核对你的计划。

hint.faq.en: The FAQ often carries rulings on edge cases: read the changed answers.
hint.faq.zh: FAQ 里常有对边界情况的裁定：请阅读改动的回答。

hint.evaluation.en: The evaluation pages define the file contract and the metrics: check whether your file or your local scoring is affected.
hint.evaluation.zh: 评测页规定文件契约和指标：请检查你的文件或本地打分是否受影响。

hint.data.en: The Data page lists stages, downloads and per-board cell counts: compare it with the board contract.
hint.data.zh: 数据页列出阶段、下载和各榜细胞数：请与榜契约对照。

hint.prizes.zh: 奖项或获奖资格的文字变了。

hint.tasks.en: A task description changed: check the splits and the input and output.
hint.tasks.zh: 任务说明变了：请检查切分以及输入和输出。

issue.intro.en: The daily rules watch found a change in the board contract, the phase endpoint or the official scorer. Full entry: {link}
issue.intro.zh: 每日规则监测发现榜契约、阶段接口或官方打分器有变化。完整条目：{link}

summary.no_change.zh: 本次运行没有发现变化。
